fields.title: 📖 Judge by what Allah showed you
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“We sent down the Book to you with the truth, so that you may judge between people by what Allah showed you; and do not be an advocate for the traitors.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The judge must not become an advocate of fraud, faction, or deception. The measure is what Allah showed.
